mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, we are seeing clear skies over Harriet Park with a temperature of 70 degrees and an air quality index of 56, which is in the moderate range. We also have a waning crescent moon lighting up the sky tonight.

The Verona Plan Commission is preparing to review development projects, including a site plan for 201 South Main Street. Additionally, the city has finalized the student designs for the upcoming I Voted sticker contest, which will be featured in the November election.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.

In terms of recent police activity, officers were called to assist the Dane County Sheriff's Office on August 8 regarding a vehicle rollover crash, where the driver was eventually arrested for an O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. Since Culver's is currently closed, you can look forward to stopping by when they open at 10 AM tomorrow morning.
